lastCompletedStory.title: List internal commands in cam --help and document the deterministic flags

nextStoryContext: US-002 added a new top-level 'Internal' HelpSection (entries-only, no body) to HELP in index.ts listing sidecar/orch-recycle-watch/sidecar-liveness-watch/orch-budget with 'Not a user entry point' descriptions, and a `--file-local` entry to ISSUE_HELP's Arguments section (name kept short, well under the 24-char NAME_COL_WIDTH threshold from the CAM-217 gotcha, so the description column stays properly spaced). JOURNAL_HELP already documented the stdin JSON schema (cycleId, title, started, ...) and ISSUE_HELP already documented close/abandon from prior stories -- both were verified via the rendered `--help` output and left untouched, no restructuring. All 8 acceptance-criteria oracles (internal-section presence, sidecar name, --file-local, close/abandon, cycleId, typecheck, check:all, test) were run directly and passed before commit. No new durable pattern was discovered beyond what CAM-217/CAM-220/CAM-231 already cover in patterns.md; nothing new appended.
